## Task

Describe one small, self-contained change.

## Suggested files

- `app/data.py`
- `app/checks.py`
- `app/agent.py`
- `app/dashboard.py`
- `tests/`
- `docs/`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change is covered by tests or documentation.
- [ ] Existing tests pass with `python -m pytest`.
- [ ] The README or docs are updated if behavior changes.
